lemmas.name: foldl_max_nat
lemmas.statement: ∀ (l : List Nat) (m : Nat), (List.foldl max m l = m ∨ List.foldl max m l ∈ l) ∧ m ≤ List.foldl max m l ∧ ∀ x ∈ l, x ≤ List.foldl max m l
lemmas.proof:
by intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro m; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro m
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih (max m a)
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases h1 with h | h
      · by_cases hm : m ≤ a
        · right; rw [max_eq_right hm] at h ⊢; rw [h]; simp
        · left
          have hmx : max m a = m := max_eq_left (by omega)
          rw [hmx] at h ⊢; exact h
      · right; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem a h
    · exact le_trans (le_max_left m a) h2
    · intro x hx
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx'
      · exact le_trans (le_max_right m x) h2
      · exact h3 x hx'

lemmas.name: mem_le_max
lemmas.statement: ∀ (s : List Nat) (v : Nat), v ∈ s → v ≤ s.foldl max 0
lemmas.proof:
by intro s v h
  obtain ⟨_, _, h3⟩ := foldl_max_nat s 0
  exact h3 v h
